correctness.rationale: The explicit root-link identity L=B union_i(y_i*B_{-i}) admits a root-fixed G-equivariant PL deformation to B because m>=2 and all q_i>0; the equivariant gluing theorem gives the deletion equivalence. Each star has the natural integral augmentation first-homology lattice by Mayer–Vietoris, and integral join Kunneth yields the stated free top module in degree 2m-1 with unsigned factor permutations. Cyclic tensor trace reduces to fixed leaves minus one per branch cycle. Seven complete mod-two chain tests and 140 signed Lefschetz tests pass; the general proof does not depend on experiments.

value.rationale: The exact topological type, integer sphere multiplicities and full natural integral symmetry representation answer a motivated gap left by general all-tree vertex decomposability. Two independent unbounded dimensions (number of branches and their sizes) and arbitrary nonuniform vectors are covered; group-element trace formulas resolve orbit structure invisible to Betti ranks. The result is not an arbitrary finite datum or a mere special-case restatement of the perfect regular-tree theorem.
